recent_articles.title: Ladakh L-G Saxena launches ecological restoration project to reclaim 800 acres of barren land - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lieutenant-Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena** launched an ambitious ecological restoration project in Ladakh, aiming to reclaim nearly 800 acres of barren land near Spituk. The project utilizes excess water from the recently restored Igoo-Phey irrigation canal to replenish depleted aquifers and trigger natural vegetation growth.  Officials believe this initiative will improve soil health, create opportunities for sustainable agriculture and afforestation, and contribute to long-term ecological benefits in the region. This project aligns with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision of restoring 26 million hectares of degraded land by 2030.

recent_articles.title: Ambulance out of CM Revanth’s convoy, now reduced to three from 11 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A. Revanth Reddy**, the Chief Minister, has drastically reduced his official convoy from nine vehicles to just three as part of a fuel conservation initiative following Prime Minister Narendra Modi's call due to the West Asia crisis.  The decision resulted in the removal of an ambulance equipped with a doctor and support staff, which previously trailed the convoy for emergency medical response. While the reduction has minimized traffic disruptions, it has also raised concerns among security personnel about increased risks associated with commuters deliberately slowing down or filming the convoy.

recent_articles.title: India voices concern on US visas but sees alignment with Rubio - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** expressed concern over recent US visa restrictions, particularly those targeting Indian tech workers. **Subrahmanyam Jaishankar**, India's foreign minister, criticized the Trump administration's approach to immigration while acknowledging broad alignment on other issues with **Secretary of State Marco Rubio**.  Rubio emphasized shared values and strategic partnership between the two countries despite recent policy shifts that have strained relations.

recent_articles.title: K.C. Venugopal slams Centre, says no government to address people’s issues in the country - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K. C. Venugopal**, **general secretary of the All India Congress Committee (AICC)**, criticized the **Union government** for its handling of rising unemployment and price rise, arguing that it lacks a solution-oriented approach. He expressed concern over youth unrest and urged the government to engage with their grievances rather than resorting to suppression. Venugopal also pointed to the weakening of small businesses and job opportunities under the current administration, blaming **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for ignoring domestic crises while focusing on international engagements.

recent_articles.title: Overseas travel spending by Indians falls to $1.09 billion in March - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Indian** outward remittances for travel declined by $212.43 million to $1.09 billion in March compared to February, according to **Reserve Bank of India (RBI) data**.  The decline is attributed to the ongoing conflict in West Asia and Prime Minister Narendra Modi's call for reduced foreign travel. The largest portion of travel spending was allocated to "other travel" which includes holiday trips and international credit card settlements, accounting for nearly 57% of the total travel outgo at $1.09 billion.  The data also reveals a decrease in spending on education-related travel, overseas business travel, pilgrimage, and medical treatment.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi Jhalmuri break: Security stepped up at stall which Modi had visited in West Bengal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bikram Kumar Sau**, a Jhalmuri vendor in Jhargram town, West Bengal, has reported receiving threatening phone calls and messages after **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** visited his stall during the state assembly election campaign.  The **Jhargram police** have launched an investigation into the threats, with security personnel posted outside the stall to protect Sau and his family. The incident gained national attention and contributed to the BJP's victory in the district.

recent_articles.title: US police responding to dozens of shots fired near the White House | News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **FBI Director Kash Patel** and **President Donald Trump** were reportedly inside the White House when shots were fired near the building.  Multiple emergency vehicles cordoned off access to the White House, with police and National Guard troops blocking reporters from entering the area. The Secret Service is working to corroborate reports of gunfire near 17th Street and Pennsylvania Avenue NW. No injuries have been reported at this time.

recent_articles.title: India is important to the U.S.’s Indo-Pacific policy, says Rubio, invites Modi to Washington - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Secretary of State Marco Rubio** began a four-day trip to India, meeting with **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and other officials.  Rubio emphasized the importance of the Indo-Pacific region and renewed the Quad engagement, highlighting India's role in U.S. policy. The visit included bilateral talks with **External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar**, attendance at the Quad Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, and a reception hosted by the U.S. Ambassador to India.  The trip also included cultural exchanges and visits to Jaipur and Agra.

recent_articles.title: Congress slams Centre over rising fuel prices, questions PM for not disclosing seriousness of crisis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders criticized the **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** government for its handling of rising fuel prices, accusing it of "looting" consumers with high taxes and failing to pass on benefits during periods of low global crude prices.  **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge accused the government of timing fuel price reductions around elections and resuming hikes after polling concluded. **Rajeev Gowda**, a Congress research department chairman, argued that rising fuel prices and the depreciating rupee reflected broader economic distress and called for greater transparency from the government regarding its energy policies.

recent_articles.title: U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai booked over ‘objectionable’ comment on PM Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ajay Rai**, **Uttar Pradesh Congress president**, is facing an FIR after a complaint from **Neeraj Kumar Rawat**, a BJP district working committee member, alleging abusive remarks against **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.  The complaint claims that Mr. Rai obstructed government work and blocked a public road with his convoy of vehicles and supporters. The police registered the case based on a video circulating online showing Mr. Rai making objectionable statements. Mr. Rai denies the allegations, calling it a tactic to silence him and accusing the BJP government of using state apparatus against opponents.

recent_articles.title: Trump says Iran agreement ‘largely negotiated’, awaiting finalisation | News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump** announced that a Memorandum of Understanding in ceasefire talks to end the US-Israel war with Iran has been largely negotiated, and will include reopening the Strait of Hormuz. The agreement is subject to finalization by US and Iranian negotiators and various other countries, following a call with Middle East leaders including **Benjamin Netanyahu**.  The announcement comes after weeks of fluctuating statements from Trump regarding the deal's progress, and a visit by Pakistan’s army chief to Iran that was deemed "highly productive".

recent_articles.title: Karnataka to soon get India’s second largest international cricket stadium - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister of **Karnataka**, announced the construction of a new international cricket stadium in Suryanagar, Anekal Taluk. The 80,000-seat stadium will be the second largest in India and is expected to boost sports development, tourism, and economic growth in the area.  The project has faced opposition from some farmers and environmentalists who raised concerns about the impact on wildlife and land value. **Siddaramaiah** assured that farmers would receive fair compensation and land allocation for their surrendered properties. The CM also launched the 'Namma Mane' housing programme, which will provide affordable housing to residents of Suryanagar.

recent_articles.title: Centre committed to ensuring transparent, corruption-free recruitmentm says Union Minister Joshi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pralhad Joshi**, **Union Minister for Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution**,  emphasized the **Centre's** commitment to transparent recruitment processes during a Rozgar Mela in Hubballi. He urged newly appointed candidates to serve with integrity and dedication, highlighting Prime Minister Narendra Modi's "Rozgar Parva" initiative which aims to create employment opportunities across India. Over 51,000 candidates received appointment letters from various departments including Railways, banking, and postal services.

recent_articles.title: DMK, Congress trade barbs over the latter’s post-poll alliance with the TVK - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DMK** leader Udhayanidhi Stalin accused the **Congress** of being responsible for the BJP's victories, claiming they had "shed blood and tears" to ensure Congress wins.  **DMK** president M.K. Stalin was also present at the meeting where a resolution condemned the **Congress** for its betrayal and labeled it a "parasite".  The **Congress** Legislature Party leader S. Rajesh Kumar countered these accusations, stating that the people of Tamil Nadu elected the **AIADMK** to power based on the promise of sharing power with alliance partners.

recent_articles.title: Govt. to soon bring in an AI policy to transform Bihar: CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** announced the state government's intention to introduce an AI policy, aiming to transform Bihar into an AI hub.  He highlighted the potential of AI in India's communication revolution and emphasized the importance of collaboration with younger generations. The summit, organized by the IT Department in collaboration with the **Bihar Industries Association (BIA)** and Qlass EdTech, saw participation from Deputy Chief Minister **Bijendra Prasad Yadav**, Information Technology Minister **Nitish Mishra**, and founder of BharatGPT **Ankush Agrawal**.

recent_articles.title: China mine blast: Death toll rises to 82; Beijing orders crackdown as rescue ops continue — top developments - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A deadly gas explosion at a coal mine in Shanxi province, China has killed at least 82 people. The blast occurred on Friday evening at the Liushenyu mine, injuring over 120 others and leaving several missing.  **PM Modi** offered condolences to **President Xi Jinping** and the Chinese people. Authorities launched an investigation into the incident and vowed to crack down on illegal mining practices nationwide. Rescue operations are ongoing, with authorities deploying a large number of emergency personnel.

recent_articles.title: India's Cockroach Janta Party claims website has been blocked
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cockroach Janta Party** (CJP), an Indian political parody group, claims its website has been blocked in the country just days after launching. The group's founder, Abhijeet Dipke, alleges that Indian officials took down the site and questioned their fear of cockroaches.  Dipke also reported that both his personal Instagram and the CJP's account have been hacked.  The CJP satirizes the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and claims to represent the unemployed youth in India.

recent_articles.title: US Secretary of State kicks off India visit, invites Modi to White House | Narendra Modi News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **US Secretary of State Marco Rubio** kicked off a four-day visit to India, inviting Prime Minister Narendra Modi to the White House and focusing on mending ties following trade frictions.  Rubio discussed issues like energy security, with India particularly hard-hit by the US-Israeli war in Iran, and called for increased cooperation between the two countries. The trip also included a meeting of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, a grouping of the US, Japan, Australia, and India, aimed at countering China's influence in the region.  Rubio emphasized the importance of deepening trade and defense cooperation and accelerating collaboration on critical technologies.

recent_articles.title: India’s government orders handover of exclusive Delhi Gymkhana Club | India | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Indian government** has ordered the **Delhi Gymkhana Club**, a prestigious private club, to vacate its premises by June 5th. The ministry of housing and urban affairs cited public interest requirements for defense and security infrastructure as justification for the eviction.  This move comes amidst a broader political shift by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**, who has sought to challenge traditional elites and reshape India's colonial past. The club, founded in 1913, has long been associated with the rich and famous but has faced internal disputes and allegations of financial mismanagement in recent years.

recent_articles.title: Rubio meets Modi, renewing ties with India after US-China summit - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Secretary of State Marco Rubio** invited **Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to visit the White House, reaffirming the importance of the US-India partnership.  Rubio's visit followed a week after the US held a summit with China and included meetings with religious leaders and a focus on shared values. recent_articles.title: Government plans to inaugurate Bhogapuram Airport on July 5: MP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M. Sribharat**, an MP, announced that the **State government** plans to inaugurate the International Airport at Bhogapuram on July 5th with Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**. recent_articles.title: Nomura picks 6 stocks with up to 49% upside potential that can benefit from India’s EV push - EV Boost | The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nomura**, an international brokerage, predicts a surge in **India's** electric vehicle (EV) adoption due to government policies and rising fuel prices. recent_articles.title: Rubio starts first visit to India on heels of US-China summit - World - DAWN.COM

He then traveled to New Delhi, where he is scheduled to meet with **Modi** later on Saturday. The trip comes as **President Donald Trump** has shifted US priorities and relations with both India and China have become more complex.

recent_articles.title: Marco Rubio visits India to sell energy as Iran oil shock persists
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **US Secretary of State Marco Rubio** arrived in India on Saturday for a four-day visit amid geopolitical tensions and an energy crisis triggered by the Iran war. He will meet with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and discuss ways to increase US energy exports to India, which imports over 80% of its energy needs. The visit comes amid ongoing trade negotiations between **India** and the US, as well as tensions surrounding Pakistan and Iran.

recent_articles.title: Innovation begins with understanding the fundamentals: Prakash Balasubramanian - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prakash Balasubramanian**, senior director at **Infineon Technologies**, emphasized the importance of foundational knowledge for technological breakthroughs during the inauguration of "Nirmaan Utsav" in Kalaburagi city. He highlighted the evolution of technologies over decades and urged students to think innovatively. Deputy Commissioner of Police (Law and Order) Shaloo encouraged students to combine academic learning with practical experience and stay updated on emerging fields like drones, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. HKE Society president and MLC Shashil Namoshi noted that **PDA Engineering College** is nurturing future-ready students through events like "Nirmaan Utsav."

recent_articles.title: Elected government has no role in Jammu demolitions, says Farooq Abdullah - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Farooq Abdullah**, president of the **National Conference (NC)**, stated that the elected government has no involvement in the ongoing demolitions in Jammu.  He accused the opposition parties of pursuing anti-Gujjar policies and claimed that Gujjars and Bakerwals have historically protected the region's borders. **Gulam Ali Khatana**, a BJP Rajya Sabha member, countered by accusing the NC and Congress of neglecting the development of Gujjar and Pahari communities for decades. He praised the Modi government's efforts to empower these communities.

recent_articles.title: Rubio's maiden India visit aims to repair strained ties; boost Quad cooperation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio** will visit **India** from May 23 to 26, 2026, aiming to repair strained bilateral ties.  He will meet with **External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar**, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, and attend a Quad Foreign Ministers meeting in New Delhi. The trip follows a recent three-day visit by **India's Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri** to Washington DC focused on stabilizing the relationship.  The talks are expected to focus on bolstering ties in energy, trade, investment, critical technology, and people-to-people exchanges, as well as discussing the West Asia crisis and its economic impact.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan’s army chief in Iran as US’s Rubio says ‘slight progress’ in talks | US-Israel war on Iran News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pakistan’s** army chief, Field Marshal Asim Munir, is in Tehran to mediate between **Israel** and the **United States**, as part of ongoing efforts to end their war.  **Iran’s** Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Esmaeil Baghaei, stated that while progress has been made, a deal is not yet close. recent_articles.title: Marco Rubio visits India: What’s at stake with Trump-Modi ties strained? | International Trade News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Marco Rubio**, US Secretary of State, is visiting India for a three-day trip ahead of the Quad meeting on May 26th. recent_articles.title: Picked wrong Melody? Parle Industries shares hit 5% upper circuit for 3rd day - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: During a visit to Italy, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** gifted **Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni** a bag of candies called "Melody." The viral video of the exchange sparked interest in Indian brands and led to marketing campaigns by companies like **Air India**.  The candy's maker, **Parle Products**, confirmed it is exported to 100 countries. While Parle Industries shares saw a significant jump following the incident, the company has no immediate plans for an initial public offering.

recent_articles.title: Voter confusion fears over simultaneous polls ‘misplaced’, says ONOE JPC chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.P. Chaudhary**, chairman of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on ‘One Nation One Election’, defended the proposal, arguing that Indian voters are politically astute and can differentiate between national and state issues.  He cited examples from Delhi and other states where voters supported different parties in Lok Sabha and Assembly elections. **CII**, **ASSOCHAM**, and **GCCI** backed the proposal, while **Gujarat University Vice-Chancellor Dr. Neerja Gupta** highlighted how frequent polls disrupt academic schedules and increase financial costs. The committee also heard concerns from the **Congress**, which argued that simultaneous elections would allow national narratives to overshadow state issues.

recent_articles.title: Take forward reforms, PM tells Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** convened a full Council of Ministers meeting in New Delhi on Thursday, May 21, 2026. The session focused on the government's reform agenda amidst geopolitical shifts and saw presentations from various ministries including labor, power, commerce, finance, agriculture, railways, and NITI Aayog.  The meetings reviewed past achievements and future plans, outlining targets for each ministry.

recent_articles.title: Parody Cockroach Janta political party’s rise reflects youth anger in India | India | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A satirical online movement, the Cockroach Janta (People's) party, has gained significant traction in India.  **Abhijeet Dipke**, a political communications strategist and student at Boston University, founded the movement after **Surya Kant**, the Supreme Court chief justice, sparked backlash with comments comparing unemployed young people to cockroaches. The CJP uses absurdist humor to mock corruption, joblessness, and government dysfunction, attracting millions of followers on social media.  While some dismiss it as a digital gimmick, Dipke believes it reflects mounting frustration among India's youth and could lead to real political change.

recent_articles.title: India's 'Cockroach Janta Party' goes viral, spotlights Gen Z worries - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A five-day-old group called the **Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)** has gained significant traction in India, surpassing the Instagram followers of the ruling **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.  The CJP, founded by 30-year-old Abhijeet Dipke, addresses issues like unemployment, inflation, and political representation, resonating with a large segment of young Indians who feel ignored by mainstream politics. The group's rapid growth reflects the anxieties felt by India's youth, as highlighted in a recent Deloitte Global survey that found Gen Z facing financial stress and postponing major life decisions due to economic concerns. Dipke emphasizes the CJP's commitment to democratic and peaceful means of political engagement, while also acknowledging its potential for significant change within Indian politics.

recent_articles.title: Parle Industries hits upper circuit amid ‘Melody’ confusion - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parle Industries** shares surged 5% on Wednesday after a social media video showed **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** giving a 'Melody' toffee to his Italian counterpart, **Giorgia Meloni**. The stock's trading volume spiked significantly, exceeding its two-week average. This is not an isolated incident; similar mix-ups have occurred in the past with companies like LG Electronics India and Tata Motors, highlighting the potential for confusion among retail investors during market volatility.

recent_articles.title: PM busy handing out candies in Italy amid economic storm at home, says Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's economic policies, accusing it of prioritizing publicity over addressing rising inflation, unemployment, and weakening economic indicators.  **Kharge** highlighted the increase in average debt per Indian and wealth concentration among billionaires, while **Gandhi** criticized the Prime Minister's focus on foreign trips during a time of economic distress. Congress officials also pointed to the rupee's decline, falling foreign exchange reserves, and large investor outflows as evidence of government mismanagement.

recent_articles.title: No double standards, we condemn Russia, U.S. and Israel for international law violations: Norway’s Foreign Minister - The Hindu

He highlighted the potential for increased trade, technology transfer, and renewable energy cooperation as key areas of focus. While Norway prefers India reduce its reliance on Russian oil, it acknowledges India's concerns regarding energy security.

recent_articles.title: Modi, Shah are traitors who are attacking the Constitution, says Rahul at Rae Bareli meet - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress** party, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, accusing them of attacking the Constitution and supporting industrialists. He also warned of an impending economic crisis, stating that it would disproportionately affect ordinary citizens while benefiting those in power.  Gandhi unveiled a statue of Veera Pasi in Rae Bareli, highlighting his party's renewed focus on the community. He further criticized the BJP government over land acquisition policies and unemployment rates, vowing to fight for the rights of the people.

recent_articles.title: Average of 53% MPs attend meetings of 16 Parliamentary Standing Committees, PAC: data - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** has been raising concerns about the low attendance of members at parliamentary committees. recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Remove Bandi Sanjay from Union Cabinet, Kavitha tells Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kalvakuntla Kavitha**, president of the **Telangana Rakshana Sena**, urged **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to remove **Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar** from his position until the investigation and trial in the POCSO case involving his son are complete. recent_articles.title: Push for public transport exposes structural gaps - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** push for public transport, particularly metro rail, has prompted politicians and bureaucrats to use such systems. Years of underinvestment in mass rapid transit systems have led to stalled projects like the Hyderabad Metro’s second phase and the Multi-Modal Transport System (MMTS) network. The State government is also exploring a Rapid Rail Transit System (RRTS), but its suitability for urban settings remains questioned.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi arrives in Netherlands on second leg of five-nation tour - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** arrived in the Netherlands on Friday, May 15, 2026, for a two-day visit to further strengthen bilateral cooperation. **Modi** met with **Dutch counterpart Rob Jetten**, and will also meet with King Willem-Alexander and Queen Maxima. recent_articles.title: PM Modi in Netherlands LIVE: Prime Minister lauds Dutch coach’s role in Indian women’s hockey success - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Chandrababu Naidu lays foundation for Google’s ₹1.35 lakh crore AI data centre in Visakhapatnam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** laid the foundation stone for a 1-Gigawatt Google data center in Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam, marking one of India's largest foreign direct investments. The project will be managed by **Google’s subsidiary Raiden Infotech**, in partnership with **Adani Infra**, and is part of a $15 billion investment from **Google** in the state.  The center will offer large-scale data storage and AI cloud infrastructure, and an upcoming subsea cable system will connect Visakhapatnam to several countries. Union Ministers, IT Minister Nara Lokesh, and representatives from Google, Adani Group, and Airtel Nxtra attended the ceremony.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: On Tuesday, April 28, 2026, **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** laid the foundation stone for a Google data center in Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam. The project will be inaugurated in September 2028 and is expected to position Andhra Pradesh as an international data gateway for India.

recent_articles.title: Raghu Rai: The photographer who showed India to itself
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Raghu Rai**, a celebrated Indian photojournalist, passed away at the age of 83.  His career spanned over five decades, documenting India's most defining events and shaping how the nation viewed its history. **Rai** began his career at The Statesman newspaper in 1966 and later worked as photo editor for **India Today** and **Sunday** magazines. He joined **Magnum Photos** in 1977, a prestigious photography agency that has influenced generations of photographers. His photographs captured political power, everyday life, and the Sikh militancy in Punjab during the 1980s.  His work is recognized for its artistic merit and its ability to capture the essence of India's people and culture. **Rai** was lauded by prominent figures such as **Narendra Modi**, who called him a "creative stalwart," and photographers who described his work as bridging reportage and art.

recent_articles.title: India names BJP leader envoy to Bangladesh as ties thaw - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** appointed veteran politician Dinesh Trivedi as its next high commissioner to **Bangladesh**, a move aimed at strengthening ties with the country.  Trivedi, a former railways and health minister who joined the **Bharatiya Janata Party** in 2021, will be tasked with rebuilding trust after strained relations following a popular uprising that forced **Bangladesh's Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina** to flee to India. The appointment comes as **India** seeks to counter Chinese influence in the region and improve ties with **Bangladesh**, which has been seeking increased fuel and fertilizer supplies from **India**.

recent_articles.title: Haryana Assembly passes women empowerment resolution; Congress boycotts session - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Haryana State Assembly** passed a resolution to form a Special Committee on women empowerment, despite the **Congress party's boycott** of the session.  **Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** stated that the committee would support Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision for women empowerment and called out the opposition's "anti-approach" towards women's rights. Former Chief Minister **Bhupinder Singh Hooda**, leader of the **Congress party**, accused the BJP government of making a mockery of constitutional institutions by convening the session on a matter that falls under the jurisdiction of the Central government.

recent_articles.title: BJP stages protest against Kharge’s remarks on Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **BJP Yuva Morcha** members in Kalaburagi protested against **AICC president Mallikarjun Kharge's** remarks calling **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** a "terrorist." The protesters demanded an apology from **Mr. Kharge**, criticizing his derogatory statement and the Congress' opposition to the Women's Reservation Bill (Nari Shakti Bill).  The protest march, led by **Virendra Patil Raikod**, included several prominent BJP leaders including **Basavaraj Mattimod** and **Rajkumar Patil Telkur**.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal election 2026: Mood of Bengal suggests BJP victory in polls, will return during oath-taking ceremony: PM Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** addressed a rally in Barrackpore, West Bengal on the final day of campaigning for the Assembly elections. He expressed confidence that the **BJP** would form the next government and asserted his intention to return for the oath-taking ceremony after May 4th.  **Modi** accused the ruling **TMC** of presiding over “syndicate raj”, political violence, and economic decline, while promising employment opportunities for youth and a focus on restoring West Bengal's prosperity. He also appealed to Matua voters, assuring them of citizenship rights and protection against illegal infiltration.
